column1: # An entry cited by a guideline counts as covered automatically and needs no row
# here. This file is for the other two outcomes: decided against, or decided to
# do something and not done yet.
# A verdict decides one question only: does this entry deserve a RULE in the
# guidelines? It never removes anything from the index — every entry stays
# greppable with its migration hint, which is what a project taken over from
# A not-relevant reason therefore names the mechanism that already covers the
# entry — ExtensionScanner, PHPStan, PHP itself, or a grep in the index. Never
# the current project inventory: "we do not use it" is wrong the day a legacy
# project arrives, and that is the day the entry is looked up.
# Without this file the audit reports the same hundreds of candidates on every
# run and stops being read. Record a verdict for everything the audit shows.
